ko.title: Passive Tonal Architecture — 부품값의 레시피가 아니라 loading·filtering·routing 구조로 패시브 톤 시스템을 설계하기
ko.excerpt: 패시브 기타·베이스 전자계를 pickup ZPU(f)를 둘러싼 controlled loading, filtering, routing, source reconfiguration, bypass/reference-state architecture로 재정의한다.

en.title: Passive Tonal Architecture — Designing a passive tone system through loading, filtering, routing, and reference state
en.excerpt: Reframe passive guitar/bass electronics as an architecture around frequency-dependent pickup ZPU(f): controlled loading, filtering, routing, source reconfiguration, and explicit reference states.
